# WELL fiscal 2017 annual report (10-K), page 116

Authoritative, audited figures.

Welltower inc. Notes to consolidated financial statements is no longer present (and additional weight may be given to subjective evidence such as our projections for growth). The valuation allowance rollforward is summarized as follows for the periods presented (in thousands): year ended december 31, 2017 2016 2015.

|   | Year Ended December 31, 2017 |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 2015 |  |  |
| Beginning balance | $89,091 | $98,966 | $85,207 |
| Expense (benefit) | 28,009 | (2,128) | 12,658 |
| Ending balance | $117,100 | $89,091 | $98,966 |

As a result of certain acquisitions, we are subject to corporate level taxes for any related asset dispositions that may occur during the five-year period immediately after such assets were owned by a c corporation ("built-in gains tax "). The amount of income potentially subject to this special corporate level tax is generally equal to the lesser of (a) the excess of the fair value of the asset over its adjusted tax basis as of the date it became a reit asset, or (b) the actual amount of gain. Some but not all gains recognized during this period of time could be offset by available net operating losses and capital loss carryforwards. During the year ended december 31, 2016, we acquired certain additional assets with built-in gains as of the date of acquisition that could be subject to the built-in gains tax if disposed of prior to the expiration of the applicable ten-year period. We have not recorded a deferred tax liability as a result of the potential built-in gains tax based on our intentions with respect to such properties and available tax planning strategies.

# WELL Fiscal 2017 Valuation Allowance Rollforward

## Figures from the Annual Report (10-K)

- **Expense (Benefit)** (Year Ended December 31, 2017): $28,009 (thousands)
- **Beginning Balance** (Year Ended December 31, 2017): $89,091 (thousands)
- **Ending Balance** (Year Ended December 31, 2017): $117,100 (thousands)
- **Beginning Balance** (Year Ended December 31, 2016): $98,966 (thousands)
- **Ending Balance** (Year Ended December 31, 2016): $89,091 (thousands)

## Percentage Change in the Balance Valuation Allowance Rollforward during 2017

The percentage change in the balance valuation allowance rollforward during 2017 is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{\text{Ending Balance (2017)} - \text{Beginning Balance (2017)}}{\text{Beginning Balance (2017)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{117,100 - 89,091}{89,091} \right) \times 100 \approx 31.44\% \]

### Source Files
- **Annual Report (10-K)**: `documents/report.md`
- **Management Commentary**: `documents/call_transcript.md`
